readiness.reason: F-001 (HIGH) is confirmed in source. playlist.ts:83 reads e.status, which AuthFetchError never sets, and :91 runs markSaved() unconditionally. A failed load therefore shows an empty playlist as saved, and saving it could overwrite the real playlist on a 24/7 playout. F-002 is also confirmed (auth.ts:235-248 logs out on any refresh failure). Neither has a fix, and no runtime or browser tests exist.
